Everything you need to ship from India to Bolivia or import from Bolivia to India: the trade agreement, routes and transit times, how your buyer imports, duties, regulators and documents.
India and Bolivia at a glance
India exports pharmaceuticals, vehicles and motorcycles, textiles and chemicals. India buys gold and other minerals.
Routes and transit times to Bolivia
50–65 days door to Bolivian city. A landlocked country: cargo discharges in Arica or Iquique (Chile) or Ilo (Peru) and moves inland by road in transit.
Transit times are indicative port-to-port from Nhava Sheva / Mundra (sea) and Delhi / Mumbai (air). Routing changes (for example Red Sea diversions) can add 10–14 days.
Importing into Bolivia: what your buyer needs
The importer must be registered with the Aduana Nacional (padrón de operadores).
A customs agency handles the clearance; transit through Chile is under bilateral transit arrangements.
GA tariff (0–40%), plus 13% IVA (calculated "inside" the price, so about 14.9% effective) and ICE excise on some goods.
SENASAG: food, plant and animal health
IBMETRO: metrology and some technical regulations

From Bolivia to India, and tips from the field
File the Bill of Entry through a licensed customs broker in India (YAM holds licence R-7/92).
Check the HS code in the Indian tariff, the DGFT import policy (free, restricted or prohibited) and any BIS, FSSAI, plant quarantine or other permit before the goods ship.
If an agreement applies, get the correct certificate of origin from the exporter to claim the lower duty.
Plan for transit-cargo procedures at Arica: delays at the border are common in peak months.
